test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The workers had been repairing / the mall road in / town for / several days now.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the past perfect continuous tense: "**had been repairing**".
 
• This tense is incorrect in conjunction with the phrase "**now**".
 
• The correct phrase should be "**have been repairing**" to indicate an action that started in the past and is still ongoing.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The workers have been repairing the mall road in town for several days now."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "the mall road in"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "several days now"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "town for"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
